questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes “Introduction to Python”?
options: Variables name and reuse values; aliases to a mutable list share the same object, so a change through one name is visible through the other.
Syntax and indentation mark code-block boundaries; a mistake can prevent a route or condition from running.
Python is used for automation, web services, and data analysis because its readable syntax and broad library ecosystem make small, testable steps practical.
Comments explain a non-obvious decision instead of repeating the code, such as why a particular limit was chosen.
